clauses.text: Net 30 payment terms are preferred. Net 45 may be accepted only with written Procurement Manager approval before contract signature.
The supplier's aggregate liability cap must be at least the total fees paid or payable during the 12 months before the event giving rise to the claim.
If the supplier processes customer personal data, a signed Data Processing Addendum must be included before data access begins.
The supplier must notify the company of a confirmed security incident affecting company or customer data within 72 hours of discovery.
Initial and renewal terms may not exceed 12 months. The company must have at least 60 days' notice to opt out of automatic renewal.
